audience.programmeDescription: Utrecht’s Veterinary Medicine bachelor studies animal health and disease through organ systems, from cells and tissues to circulation, digestion, reproduction and movement. Clinical skills and professional development run throughout the three years.
audience.comparisonExplanation: UCR offers related coursework in epidemiology, infection, animal behaviour, welfare and farming. Utrecht connects these subjects to the anatomy and diseases of different animal species and to clinical examination, diagnosis and treatment. The available UCR courses cover parts of that work, with insufficient coverage for a comparable programme.

curriculum.limitation: The curriculum includes 22.5 EC of profiling courses. The 7.5 EC thesis is part of the third-year professional sequence.

componentNotes.vet-approved-free-profiling-space: Choose 15 EC in period 4 of year 2. Across both profiling periods, at least 7.5 EC must be outside Veterinary Medicine.
componentNotes.vet-approved-free-profiling-space-2: Choose 7.5 EC in period 3 of year 3 alongside the thesis. Choices must meet Utrecht’s level and overlap rules.
componentNotes.vet-vet-y3-8: Includes the 7.5 EC independent thesis. The supervisor and at least one other examiner assess it.
